set.body:
Port the useful spline/acquisition behavior without copying volregger API shape.

Contracts: RigidSpline layers over a rigid estimate; SliceTiming and PacketTiming validate against z dimension and TR metadata; zero packet offsets are byte-identical to rigid application; nonzero packet offsets evaluate interpolated poses during final application.

Deliverables: shared timing ADTs, deterministic spline/pose interpolation, packet-aware apply path, packet correction diagnostics in MotionQc, and fixture-backed tests against src/api_spline.cpp and test-synthetic-ablation-modes.R.

Acceptance: invalid timing and multiband groupings are MotionError values; JVM/JS shared tests cover zero-offset identity, nonzero packet differences, and reference-frame preservation.
set.title: Implement motion spline and acquisition timing core
